method: Actual read-only AI agent reading of the five full drafts, followed by rereading the revised scene11/14 and article agreement wording. Native Node parsed all scene ids/sentence counts and article event-table cells and compared production states after independent execution. No source mutation, Git operation or production-code import.

checks.name: Conditions and derivation
checks.observations: Known initial OFF, one visitor, private memory, preagreement and individual fairness are explicit. Repeated visits motivate counting distinct one-time contributions before assigning counter/sender roles.

checks.name: One-time contribution semantics
checks.observations: First successful OFF-to-ON is distinguished from first entry. An unsent person seeing ON retains eligibility; an already sent person cannot resend even when later seeing OFF. Only the agreed counter clears ON and increments.

checks.name: Same four-person trace
checks.observations: Scenes05..11 cover e01..e12 in order without reset: [1,2,1,0,1,2,3,0,0,3,3,0]. Exact parsed table and all before/after states match independent execution.

checks.name: Knowledge and announcement boundary
checks.observations: Global sent/visited/pending identities are teaching or audit data only. At e07 all have actually visited but the counter cannot yet announce; at e10/e11 all senders have sent but count is2. At e12 the final OFF and count3 precede confirmation. Latest11 uses都来过, not simultaneous arrival; latest14 explicitly says每个发信人.

checks.name: Threshold and general safety
checks.observations: For100 people there are99 senders, with count0 initially and target99. S=C+L is correctly initialized and preserved, and count99 plus the receiving counter proves all100 visited.

checks.name: Fair liveness and waiting bound
checks.observations: The article separately gives the ON/counter and OFF/unsent-worker progress cases under every-person-infinitely-often scheduling. The arbitrary-length counter-only OFF prefix can be extended fairly, refuting a uniform finite visit bound. Neither a random run nor the198-visit fixture is called a bound or optimum.

checks.name: Boundary conditions and controls
checks.observations: Unknown initial state is explicitly outside this protocol. The three wrong variants concern consuming eligibility on first entry, allowing resends and treating initial ON as an earned contribution. Physical ability to switch is distinguished from the agreement about who switches OFF.

checks.name: Article source and implementation scopes
checks.observations: Local source IDs R1/R2 exist, and article statements distinguish R1 shifted bookkeeping and R2 last-announcement action variant. Production finite counts10916/82639/1122660 match the recorded production result; the independent Node assertion count1615775 is not substituted for that count. No external-source date/title/quote verification is claimed by this reviewer.

checks.name: Plan, pronunciation and visual direction
checks.observations: 14 scene ids/slugs,28 sentences and5 chapters agree. Pronunciation instructions preserve counter/signal/number meanings. Visual directions separate preview from actual main events, shared lamp0/1 from person0/1, and sent from received; actual timing/layout requires later audiovisual QA.
